matching_prs.title: Fix CI configuration and create minimal CLI
matching_prs.classification: Attempted CI and test repair, superseded
matching_prs.weakness: CI pointed at the wrong package. The binding-specific brightness test depended on private DNG data and unavailable histogram helpers.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Redirect CI to the internal packages and remove the blocked diagnostic. The proposed Make target also suppressed every test failure.
diff_evidence: TestGolibrawBrightness used DecodeRaw and failed if brightness was below 1.0. Its function body was removed and replaced by explanatory comments.

The workflow changed from testing ./cmd/olsen/... to make test. Its recipe ran CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -v ./internal/... || true. The proposed CLI entry point was missing from the changed-file inventory.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep a required test command's exit status meaningful. Isolate an unavailable dependency and retain an executable check for binding-specific behavior where feasible.
matching_prs.outcome: Closed unmerged. The head has no GitHub check runs or commit statuses. The test, Makefile and CI diffs are identical to those in merged PR #2.

matching_prs.title: Fix CI: Add missing CLI and correct all configuration
matching_prs.classification: CI and test repair with a false-green outcome
matching_prs.weakness: The original CI path missed the intended tests. SQLite required CGO and the RAW diagnostic depended on private data and unavailable helpers.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Supersede #1 with the missing CLI source, run the internal packages and remove the RAW brightness test. Keep CI green by allowing all test failures.
diff_evidence: The test, Makefile and workflow patches match #1 exactly. The brightness assertion disappeared, and make test invoked CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -v ./internal/... || true.
The replacement added cmd/olsen/main.go, addressing the missing entry point. Its presence could satisfy a build while the test command still masked failures.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Separate unsupported cases from required coverage and verify that a deliberately failing required assertion makes CI fail.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. GitHub returned no checks or commit statuses for the final head. Merged #7 subsequently removed both blanket failure suppressions and ran the suite with CGO.

matching_prs.title: Fix audit findings: correctness bugs, security, CI, and code quality
matching_prs.classification: Test repair embedded in a production audit
matching_prs.weakness: CI could pass while tests failed. CLI tests required a prebuilt binary, facet tests could query a schema-less fallback, and heavy image tests made race runs costly.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Restore failure propagation, exercise SQLite with CGO, run full and race-short suites, and build the executable under test in TestMain.
diff_evidence: The Makefile removed || true from test and test-ci. CI now runs CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -timeout 20m ./... followed by go test -race -short -timeout 20m ./....
TestMain builds a CLI binary into a temporary directory. The facet lifecycle fallback creates a schema, two historical diagnostic tests use t.Skip, and the costly burst test skips under -short.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Run required tests with production dependencies and propagate failure. Run expensive fixture cases in the full pass and budget a separate race pass.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. GitHub returned four successful final-head checks, including Test. The empty fallback could still skip behavioral coverage, and TestMain deferred cleanup before os.Exit. PR #11 repaired both.

matching_prs.title: Upgrade testing approach with 7 practices from testing-best-practices
matching_prs.weakness: Example-based tests missed facet-count and click discrepancies, shared template execution polluted subsequent renders, and persisted NULL handling lacked a discriminating check.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Add property, differential, HTTP, mutation and documentation checks, reuse fixture builders and isolate shared templates.
diff_evidence: TestFacetClickInvariant follows unselected facet URLs on generated corpora and compares the result total with the displayed count. TestYearFacetMatchesGoRecount independently recounts years. TestHammingDistanceProperties compares results with bits.OnesCount64(a ^ b).

executeGridForTest clones the shared templates before rendering. Database tests directly query IS NULL for empty persisted fields. The HTTP test reuses the returned ETag on a conditional request and requires status 304 and an empty body.

The documentation tests read CLI help to check documented commands and flags. TestResizeLibrariesAgree enforces SSIM >= 0.90 and a mean luminance difference <= 5.0. The description's 0.999 is an observed value.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Check user-visible invariants with an independent expected value. Isolate mutable test fixtures and use mutants to identify missing behavioral assertions.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. GitHub returned four passing final-head checks, including Test. The reported database mutation efficacy, local LibRaw results and measured resize similarity were not independently reproduced. Regular CI replayed the parser seeds at this point.

matching_prs.title: Fuzz URL parsing and preserve filter precision
matching_prs.classification: Explicit improvement to an existing fuzz test
matching_prs.weakness: Routine CI replayed existing FuzzParsePath seeds. Active discovery was manual, and URL formatting silently rounded valid numeric filters.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Run bounded, coverage-guided discovery in CI, preserve finite float precision and retain examples for the discovered aperture case, fractional focal lengths and non-finite inputs.
diff_evidence: CI invokes make test-fuzz FUZZTIME=10s. The Makefile sets the local default to 30s and invokes go test -fuzz FuzzParsePath.

A failed hosted run logged the round-trip invariant violation for aperture_max=.00000000000000000000000000000010, which rebuilt as /photos?aperture_max=0.0. The exact query was added as a seed and the serializer switched to lossless formatting.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Distinguish corpus replay from active generation. Run a bounded discovery job, check a semantic invariant and preserve each minimized counterexample.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. The earlier hosted job log records the failing input. The final-head job records the bounded fuzz step as successful. A fixed time budget samples inputs and cannot establish exhaustive coverage.

matching_prs.title: Test audit: seed facet/engine tests, real-SQLite temporal counts and HTTP zero-result test, compile LibRaw tests in CI, DB smoke test
matching_prs.classification: Explicit test audit, including the rebased work from #12
matching_prs.weakness: Facet and engine tests could skip on absent local data or pass without exercising a transition. A color-removal check used the wrong expected count. RAW-tagged tests were never compiled by normal CI, and the CLI smoke check only exercised informational commands.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Create deterministic SQLite fixtures, require state transitions and exact totals, compile tagged tests for both bindings and exercise the built CLI against a database. Incorporate #12's temporal, HTTP and test-deletion changes.
diff_evidence: Two fixture helpers seed temporary SQLite databases. The state machine fails when a state family exercises zero transitions and obtains the year-only expected total from the unfiltered facet. The engine asserts six photos for ISO 100–400 and two for its compound query.

make vet-raw runs go vet for both build tags. Tests update GetThumbnail to the typed size, and the Leica fixture expects ISO 8000 and 1/200s. The built CLI indexes testdata/photos, runs verify and stats, and CI requires the exact output line Total photos: 4.

The CLI TestMain now returns from a helper before calling os.Exit, so deferred cleanup runs. All six test-file patches from #12 match byte-for-byte, and its four commit subjects appear in #11's rebased history.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Design fixtures that force each expected transition, fail loudly on absent required data and check a concrete result from the packaged executable. Compile supported optional configurations.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. GitHub recorded successful final-head steps for the database smoke test and compiling the RAW-tagged tests. The tagged gate only compiles and vets. Proposed per-PR mutation runs and score thresholds were dropped before merge.

matching_prs.title: Test audit: real-SQLite temporal filter counts, HTTP zero-result test, drop tests that cannot fail
matching_prs.classification: Explicit test audit, closed and incorporated into #11
matching_prs.weakness: SQL substring checks could miss binding or padding errors. A facet and its click path could agree while both dropped a filter. Several camera and HTTP examples only logged, skipped or exercised unreached routes.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Replace SQL-shape assertions with fixture-derived SQLite counts and facet maps. Exercise valid empty-result pages through the real router, retain the actual multiword parser test and remove diagnostics with no behavioral checks.
diff_evidence: where_clause_test.go was removed. TestStateMachineIntegration requires exact totals of two for January, four for day 1, and two then six before and after removing the year filter. Under month=10 the expected nonzero year map is {2020:2, 2021:2, 2024:2}.
TestHTTPZeroResultQueryRendersEmptyState checks 200, empty-state text and zero thumbnails for two queries, plus a link preserving gray while switching to 2023. The old facet_404_test.go was removed.
Six camera diagnostics were removed and TestParsePathMultiWordCameraMake retained. The associated Make target and skip patterns were removed, with its lingering .PHONY entry cleaned up in #11.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Check exact fixture-derived results against the public boundary. When retiring a test, identify another assertion covering its contract or establish why it could never detect a defect.
matching_prs.outcome: Closed unmerged as a standalone PR. Its final-head suite passed, and its six test patches match those in merged #11. The PR reports the full old query/explorer packages missed the unpadded day and zero-results-as-404 mutants. Other proposed mutations were already caught elsewhere. The mutation campaign was not independently rerun.

exclusions.reason: Changed a detail-page template to link metadata.
UI templates plus a Go version change in CI and go.mod.
Added tests for newly introduced safety limits. The indexer test diff adds 144 lines and modifies no existing assertions.
Ruff configuration and linting. The test-data generator only reordered imports.
Restricted Ruff push triggers. Test commands and assertions stayed the same.
CI branch filters and superseded-run cancellation.
Pinned GitHub Actions and added a workflow linter for immutable action references.
Dependabot version updates for GitHub Actions.

limitations: Enumeration includes all 16 PR descriptions and complete changed-file inventories (166 PR/file entries). Patch review targeted candidate tests, runners and relevant supporting code.

No test suite or mutation campaign was run for this audit. Verification uses the historical patches, merge metadata and hosted check records identified per PR. #1/#2 and #12/#11 are separate PR attempts with overlapping work.
